"I was floating, dark as a grey blur, staring up at me. As I walked swiftly away down a gravel path someone like Barbara came running towards me in a white coat, approaching from a thick hedge that surrounded the graveyard.

The excerpt discusses the use of NLP (natural-language processing) models in analyzing ancient languages and the limitations caused by the lack of historical records.

"NLP (natural-language processing) models are capable of incredible feats, but their abilities are very much limited by the amount of context they receive. This lack of context could cause difficulties for researchers who hope to use them to do things such as analyze ancient languages. In some cases, there are few historical records on long-gone civilizations to serve as training data for such a purpose." (p. 82.)
